articles.findProviderQ: How do I find the right service provider?
articles.findProviderA: Browse a category, compare service details and provider profiles, then choose the package that matches your needs. Keep the order and conversation in Pavodah so the work has a clear record.
articles.supportAccountQ: Do I need an account before contacting support?
articles.supportAccountA: Yes. Signing in connects your support conversation to your account, shows your previous support history, and lets Pavodah safely investigate account-specific issues.
articles.updateProfileQ: How do I update my profile information?
articles.updateProfileA: Open Profile and settings, choose General settings, update the relevant details, and save your changes.
articles.forgotPasswordQ: What should I do if I forget my password?
articles.forgotPasswordA: Choose Forgot password on the sign-in screen. Pavodah will guide you through email verification before you create a new password.
articles.changePasswordQ: How do I change my password while signed in?
articles.changePasswordA: Open Profile and settings, select Change password, enter your current password, then confirm the new one.
articles.notificationsQ: How do I control notification emails and SMS?
articles.notificationsA: Notification preferences are under Profile and settings. In-app, email, and eligible critical SMS notifications can be controlled separately.
articles.trackOrderQ: Where can I track an order?
articles.trackOrderA: Open My orders to see the current order status, payment state, delivery details, messages, and any available actions.
articles.quotesA: A quote request describes the work, budget, and expected delivery. The provider can respond with updated terms before an order is created.
articles.projectDetailsQ: Where should I discuss project details?
articles.projectDetailsA: Use Pavodah Messages. Keeping the scope, delivery questions, and decisions in the conversation gives both parties a reliable record.
articles.deliveryQ: What should I do when work is delivered?
articles.deliveryA: Review the delivery from the order page. Accept it when it matches the agreed work. For a material problem, use the dispute option on an eligible order instead of resolving it outside Pavodah.
articles.paymentSuccessQ: How can I confirm whether a payment succeeded?
articles.paymentSuccessA: Return to the order page after checkout. Pavodah verifies the payment with the payment provider and shows the resulting order and payment status there.
articles.paymentFailedQ: What should I do after a failed or interrupted payment?
articles.paymentFailedA: Check the order before trying again. If no successful payment is shown, use the payment action on that order. Do not make a separate off-platform payment to the provider.
articles.refundA: Refund availability depends on the order and payment state. When a refund is initiated, its status appears with the order. Processing time can also depend on the payment provider and your financial institution.
articles.disputeQ: How do I raise and track a dispute?
articles.disputeA: For an eligible order, choose Raise dispute and explain the issue clearly. Follow the review and resolution from the Disputes area.
articles.serviceQ: How do I create or update a service?
articles.serviceA: Open My services from the provider dashboard. Add accurate service details, pricing, delivery expectations, and portfolio information before publishing.
articles.providerQuotesQ: Where do providers respond to quote requests?
articles.providerQuotesA: Open Quote requests from the provider dashboard to review the client brief and respond with terms you can deliver.
articles.earningsQ: Where can I see earnings and payout status?
articles.earningsA: The Earnings and payouts page shows eligible earnings and payout activity. A payout becomes available only when the related order and settlement state allow it.

Safety.title: Trust is built into every clear next step.
Safety.subtitle: Learn how to protect your account, keep a reliable record of marketplace work, and raise concerns through the right Pavodah channel.
Safety.rule1: Keep payment, messages, and delivery decisions in Pavodah.
Safety.rule2: Never share your password or a one-time verification code.
Safety.rule3: Stop and report pressure, impersonation, or suspicious payment requests.
Safety.platformTitle: Keep the work and conversation on Pavodah
Safety.platformBody: Use Pavodah Messages for scope, delivery questions, and important decisions. Use the order page for payment and delivery actions. This gives both parties a consistent record if support needs to understand what happened.
Safety.platform1: Do not move payment to a personal bank or mobile-money account.
Safety.platform2: Do not rely on screenshots as proof of a completed payment.
Safety.platform3: Check the order state in Pavodah before starting or releasing work.
Safety.accountBody: Pavodah support should never ask for your password or a one-time verification code. Use a password you do not reuse elsewhere, keep your email and phone current, and review unexpected security notifications promptly.
Safety.paymentsTitle: Follow the payment and order state
Safety.paymentsBody: Complete checkout through Pavodah and use order details as the source of truth. Payment, delivery, refund, and dispute states can change at different times; another user's message does not replace the status shown on the order.
Safety.correctBody: Accept the delivery using the action on the eligible order.
Safety.problemBody: Raise a dispute from the order when available and describe the issue with relevant detail.
Safety.warningBody: Suspicious behavior often uses urgency or secrecy. Do not proceed until you have checked the request through a trusted Pavodah screen.
Safety.warning1: A request to pay outside Pavodah or send an extra release fee.
Safety.warning2: A request for your password, verification code, or full payment-card details.
Safety.warning3: A link that imitates Pavodah but uses an unfamiliar web address.
Safety.warning4: Pressure to move quickly before you can review the order or profile.
Safety.warning5: Threats, harassment, impersonation, or services that appear unlawful.
Safety.reportBody: For an order-quality or payment disagreement, use the dispute action on the order when available. For suspicious behavior, account access, harassment, or anything outside an order dispute, contact Pavodah support.
Safety.emergency: If someone is in immediate danger, contact the appropriate local emergency service first. Pavodah support is not an emergency response service.
Safety.policiesBody: Read how Pavodah handles platform use and personal information.

PrivacyDocument.title: Privacy policy
PrivacyDocument.summary: This policy explains what information Pavodah uses to operate the marketplace, complete transactions, communicate with users, and protect the service.

sections.title: Information we collect
paragraphs: Pavodah collects information you provide, information created through marketplace activity, and technical information needed to operate and protect the service.
bullets: Account and profile details, such as name, email address, phone number, role, profile image, location, and provider information.
Service listings, quote requests, orders, delivery details, reviews, disputes, messages, support conversations, and files you choose to submit.

Payment, refund, settlement, and payout references and statuses. Payment providers process sensitive payment credentials according to their own services; Pavodah receives the records needed to verify and administer transactions.
Device, browser, network, authentication, and security-event information used to maintain sessions, diagnose problems, and prevent misuse.

sections.title: How information is used
bullets: Create and secure accounts, complete onboarding, and provide role-appropriate marketplace features.
Publish services, connect clients and providers, process quotes and orders, and maintain transaction records.
Verify payment events, administer refunds, settlements, and payouts, and investigate mismatches or fraud.
Deliver messages, transactional notifications, support, dispute handling, and safety responses.
Monitor reliability, diagnose errors, enforce policies, comply with legal obligations, and improve the service.

sections.title: When information is shared
paragraphs: Pavodah shares information only when needed to provide the marketplace, carry out a requested transaction, protect the service, or meet a legal obligation.
bullets: Clients and providers receive the profile, order, quote, delivery, review, and conversation information needed for their marketplace relationship.
Payment, communication, file-storage, analytics, and infrastructure providers receive information needed to perform services for Pavodah.
Authorized administrators may access information needed for support, disputes, payments, payouts, security, and platform operations.
Information may be disclosed when required by law or reasonably necessary to protect rights, safety, users, or the integrity of Pavodah.

sections.title: Notifications and communications
paragraphs: Pavodah sends transactional communications about account security, messages, orders, payments, refunds, disputes, reviews, support, settlements, and payouts. Available in-app, email, and SMS preferences can be managed from Profile and settings, although certain service or security communications may still be necessary to operate the account.
Marketing communication, when offered, is handled separately from transactional notification preferences.

sections.title: Retention and security
paragraphs: Pavodah retains information for as long as needed to provide the service, maintain marketplace and financial records, resolve disputes, protect users, and meet legal obligations. Different record types may require different retention periods.

Administrative, technical, and organizational safeguards are used to reduce unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or loss. No internet service can guarantee absolute security, so report suspected account compromise promptly.

sections.title: Your choices
bullets: Review and update available profile and notification settings from your account.
Use the password-reset or password-change flow when account credentials need to be updated.
Contact support to ask about access, correction, deletion, restriction, or another privacy request. Some information may need to be retained for transactions, safety, disputes, or legal compliance.

sections.title: Children's privacy
paragraphs: Pavodah is not intended for children who cannot legally agree to marketplace transactions or these terms. If you believe a child submitted personal information without appropriate authorization, contact support for review.

sections.title: Changes and contact
paragraphs: This policy may be updated as Pavodah's features, service providers, or legal obligations change. Material changes will be communicated through an appropriate platform or account channel when required.
Privacy questions and requests can be sent to support@pavodah.com.

TermsDocument.title: Terms of service
TermsDocument.summary: These terms explain the responsibilities that keep marketplace work, payment, communication, and dispute handling clear for everyone using Pavodah.

sections.title: Using Pavodah
paragraphs: These Terms govern access to and use of the Pavodah service marketplace. By creating an account or using the platform, you agree to follow these Terms and the policies linked from them.

You must provide accurate account information, keep your login details secure, and use Pavodah only for lawful marketplace activity. You are responsible for actions taken through your account unless you promptly report unauthorized access.

sections.title: Marketplace roles
paragraphs: Pavodah provides tools that help clients discover services and providers offer and deliver them. Providers are responsible for the accuracy, legality, quality, and delivery of their services. Clients are responsible for accurate requirements and timely review.
An order, quote, message, review, or profile does not create employment, partnership, or agency between Pavodah and a marketplace user.

sections.title: Orders and payments
paragraphs: Use Pavodah checkout and the order workflow for marketplace payments. The amount, currency, fees, and available actions are shown before or during checkout and on the order record.
Payment verification, refunds, settlement, and payouts may depend on payment providers and financial institutions. A pending state does not confirm that money completed every processing stage.
bullets: Do not ask another user to move payment outside Pavodah for work arranged through Pavodah.
Do not misrepresent a payment, delivery, refund, or payout state.
Review order details before accepting delivery or taking another final action.

sections.title: Provider obligations
paragraphs: Providers must describe services honestly, use pricing and delivery terms they can honor, possess any authorization required for the work, and communicate material changes before delivery.
Providers may not publish deceptive, unlawful, infringing, unsafe, or prohibited services. Pavodah may review, limit, or remove services that create risk.

sections.title: Messages, reviews, and content
paragraphs: You remain responsible for profile information, service listings, files, messages, reviews, and dispute evidence you submit. You permit Pavodah to host, display, process, and transmit that content as needed to operate and protect the marketplace.

Content must not be fraudulent, abusive, discriminatory, unlawfully threatening, privacy-invasive, or infringing. Reviews must reflect a genuine marketplace experience and must not be manipulated for a benefit.

sections.title: Disputes and refunds
paragraphs: Eligible orders may provide an in-platform dispute action. Each party should provide accurate information and cooperate. Pavodah may consider order state, messages, delivery records, payment information, and submitted evidence.
Refund availability and amount depend on payment and order circumstances. A refund may require additional processing time after Pavodah records it as initiated or processed.

sections.title: Restriction and enforcement
paragraphs: Pavodah may restrict content, transactions, features, or accounts when reasonably necessary to investigate misuse, comply with law, protect users, address security risk, or enforce these Terms. Pavodah may request more information before restoring access.

sections.title: Availability and responsibility
paragraphs: Pavodah works to provide a reliable marketplace, but uninterrupted or error-free availability is not guaranteed. To the extent permitted by law, Pavodah is not responsible for indirect losses or for a user's independent acts, services, representations, or off-platform arrangements.
Nothing in these Terms excludes a right or responsibility that cannot lawfully be excluded.

sections.title: Changes and contact
paragraphs: Pavodah may update these Terms when the service, legal requirements, or marketplace risks change. Material updates will be communicated through an appropriate channel before they take effect when required.
Questions about these Terms can be sent to support@pavodah.com.
